item.title: 16 episode(s) — 6:59pm 23/Nov
item.description:
Interviewees:

  • Romy Stevens, Environment reporter (ABC AM)
  • Alison Reeve, Energy and Climate Change program director at the Graton Institute (ABC AM)
  • Sarah Hansen Young, Green Senator (ABC AM)
  • Anika Wells, Communications Minister (ABC AM)
  • Mike Burgess, ASIO CEO (ABC AM)
  • Elizabeth Devaney, CEO of Consumer Health Forum (ABC AM)
  • Dennis Petri, Health economist at Monash University (ABC AM)
  • Derek Dean, British choreographer (ABC AM)
  • Ivan Hillo Teega, Artistic director at Queensland Ballet (ABC AM)
  • Lauren Jackson, Head of costume at Queensland Ballet (ABC AM)
  • Dr. Peter Hotez, Professor at the Baylor College of Medicine (ABC AM)
  • Dara O'Brien, Ireland's climate minister (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Dr. Zenator Agyeman Rawlings, Guanian Environment Minister (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Chris Bowen, Australian Climate Change and Energy Minister (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Bill Hair, Physicist and climate scientist (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Murray Watt, Minister for the Environment and Water (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Michelle Blüth, Marine scientist (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Jane Hume, Deputy opposition leader and Shadow Minister for employment and industrial relations (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Dr. Eric Gbs, Senior analyst for Naval Forces and weapons at the US Congressional Budget Office (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Annabelle Hurd, Chief executive of the Australian Recording Industry Association (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Rob Stokes, Former New South Wales State Government Minister and advisory board chair for the new school at the University of New South Wales (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Scott Lucas, Professor of International Politics at University College, Dublin (ABC Radio National Breakfast)
  • Jane Gazzo, Music journalist and friend of Molly Meldrum (7AM podcast)

Key Themes:

  • COP31 climate talks collapse in Turkey without a deal over fossil fuel disagreements
  • Federal Parliament final sitting week dominated by digital duty of care, AI regulations, and cost of living pressures
  • Australia's healthcare and cost of living crisis leading to skipped medications and medical care
  • AI and national security concerns, foreign interference risks in data centers, and copyright protections for artists
  • AUKUS pact and US submarine industrial base capacity debate
  • Molly Meldrum's legacy and impact on the Australian music industry following his passing
  • Jetstar class action regarding COVID-19 flight cancellations and voucher refunds
  • Global geopolitical tensions and security risks, including Russian drone and missile incidents impacting NATO and Europe
  • Microplastics pollution and citizen science tracking via OzMaP
  • The ongoing debate and trials surrounding the implementation of a four-day work week in Australia
  • Approval of new oral GLP-1 weight-loss pills in Australia and associated accessibility concerns
